These are recommendations, not a binding rule or evidence that any government has adopted the controls or that they measurably reduce attacks. — FCMO-6F06DE2DF28B Hubei expands its 2026 consumer subsidy basket to include embodied, cooking, exoskeleton and companion robots — importance 4/10 · On 2026-09-30, Hubei’s Commerce Department issued an effective notice revising the province’s 2026 consumer-goods trade-in subsidy categories from 2026-10-01. The ten-category list now explicitly includes embodied service robots, cooking robots, exoskeletons, companion robots and robot dogs; it also reshapes smart cleaning and kitchen categories and adds cameras/drones, age-support products and smart furniture. The notice says other requirements remain unchanged. This establishes an official eligibility change, not consumer take-up, robot sales, subsidy outlays or incremental demand. — FCMO-F3EA8AB98738 Mexico’s Chamber of Deputies docket lists a federal AI governance and technology-transfer bill pending in committee — importance 4/10 · Mexico’s official SIL docket index lists a Chamber of Deputies initiative presented by José Alejandro Aguilar López (PT) on 15 September 2026 and pending in the originating committee as of that date. Its official summary describes a proposed federal risk-based governance framework for AI development, commercialization and use, and a technology-linkage program to transfer university knowledge to micro, small and medium enterprises. This is a proposal, not enacted law. The full bill text and a later committee status were not directly inspectable in this activation. — FCMO-727CB05A3E39 Hebei Daily reports one Langfang firm redeemed RMB 500,000 in compute vouchers for 42 PFLOPS of annual service — importance 3/10 · A Hebei Daily article hosted by the Langfang Municipal Government reports that Langfang ShumaoTong Technology Services redeemed RMB 500,000 in compute vouchers, described as equivalent to 42 PFLOPS of annual compute service. The same article says Langfang allocated RMB 10 million annually to vouchers and that the program had attracted nine firms. This is an attributed local press report, not a transaction ledger: no redemption record, invoice or usage log was found, and the compute unit/period basis is not independently defined. — FCMO-BEABCA756C40 reasoning_posttraining VRR uses verification feedback to expand candidate search, with mixed reported benchmark results — importance 5/10 · Tomihari and Ichikawa introduce Verify–Repair–Reselect (VRR), which feeds verifier diagnostics back into generation: after ranking an initial pool, it retains the winner, conditionally creates repairs of the winner and runner-up plus a new-approach candidate, filters invalid/duplicate outputs and reselects under the original criteria. Across two models and eight code/reasoning benchmarks, the authors report VRR beats fixed-pool LAV selection in 9 of 16 settings. Table 1 includes improvements as well as null and negative cells. On LiveCodeBench, the authors report recovery on some problems where all initial candidates were incorrect. These are paper-reported results using the same model for generation, verification and repair; matched total-inference-budget comparison with best-of-N and independent reproduction remain open. — FCMO-2BAAC79C11E5 training_data UnifiedPlayers paper reports benchmark gains from jointly training planning, execution and executable evaluation policies — importance 5/10 · The authors of arXiv:2609.20089 report UnifiedPlayers, a GRPO framework that alternately trains planning, tool-execution and executable-verifier policies using shared sandbox verdicts. On Qwen3-4B-Base and MiMo-7B-Base they report higher averages than their reimplementations of prior methods across seven math and five general reasoning/code benchmarks. A three-seed Qwen3 factorial study attributes gains to training the Planning and Evaluation players; a compute-matched stale-feedback control reports smaller scores than the full fresh-feedback method. These are paper-reported results: code and independent reproduction were not found in this review. — FCMO-52CF2BED2DE0 Published edition · 2026-10-08

CAND-2026-08-02-EU-AI-ACT-ENFORCEMENT — EU AI Act enters an enforcement phase for GPAI and transparency obligations — revisit if: Commission enforcement actions, GPAI guidance updates, Code-of-Practice implementation evidence, complaints/decisions or material court/regulator interpretations appear. CAND-2026-08-02-EU-GPAI-ENFORCEMENT — European Commission enforcement powers for general-purpose AI model obligations enter application — revisit if: The Commission announces a first GPAI enforcement action, systemic-risk notification decision, serious-incident proceeding, fine, or material interpretive update. CAND-2026-08-18-FDA-GENAI-MEDICAL-DEVICES — FDA opens competency-based regulatory framework discussion for generative-AI medical devices — revisit if: FDA publishes docket comments, workshop material, draft/final guidance, legal-authority analysis or concrete submission expectations before the deadline. CAND-2026-08-26-ANTHROPIC-CVD-SCALE — Anthropic's disclosure ledger shows AI-assisted vulnerability discovery scaling to thousands of human-reviewed findings — revisit if: The dashboard materially changes, per-model discovery attribution/cost is released, or independent organizations publish matched AI-versus-human vulnerability-discovery throughput. CAND-2026-08-26-AWS-NVIDIA-2M-GPU-EXPANSION — AWS and NVIDIA plan 2 million additional Blackwell Ultra/Rubin-class GPUs across 2027–2028 — revisit if: AWS discloses installed/deployed counts, Rubin instances reach GA, procurement/power buildout data appears, or timelines materially change. CAND-2026-08-31-3C91A8D4 — European Commission designates ChatGPT a Very Large Online Search Engine under the Digital Services Act — revisit if: The Commission publishes the designation decision, compliance deadline, systemic-risk requirements, audit/researcher-access details, enforcement actions or OpenAI implementation changes. CAND-2026-08-31-4F2C8E11 — EuroHPC signs €387.8M AMD MI430X LUMI-AI contract for 2027 deployment — revisit if: EuroHPC/CSC publish accelerator counts, peak/sustained AI performance, access policy or deployment milestones; installation begins; or the contract/system architecture materially changes. CAND-2026-08-31-54C150C8 — China MIIT launches national AI application-service-provider cultivation action — revisit if: MIIT publishes the national resource pool, procurement/compute-support figures, standards, adoption results, provider lists, or measurable model/agent deployment outcomes. CAND-2026-08-31-5BE9E260 — Signal: draft IPO documents reportedly show a $5.5B OpenAI warrant position in SB Energy as AI infrastructure financing deepens — revisit if: SB Energy IPO filing, SEC document, OpenAI/SoftBank/NVIDIA statement, audited financing document, or additional independent reporting confirms or contradicts the warrant and guarantee details. CAND-2026-08-31-A11F0A7E — Maniformer reports a million-hour multimodal human-interaction corpus and 20,000-device collection fleet for Physical AI — revisit if: Public dataset slices, model/data cards, independent quality audits, VLA scaling curves, privacy/consent documentation, customer training results or cross-embodiment transfer measurements appear. CAND-2026-08-31-A1C3550A — HUMAIN puts AMD MI355X/Cisco AI infrastructure into production in Saudi Arabia and targets a much larger sovereign compute buildout — revisit if: Installed accelerator count, power draw, acceptance benchmark, pricing, customer workload metrics, independent utilization data, MI400 phase commissioning, or sovereign-AI procurement documents appear. CAND-2026-08-31-AGENT-CAPABILITY-COST-EVAL — Agent capability-cost evaluation: cheaper failure is not a Pareto win, and run provenance is load-bearing — revisit if: A larger attempt-linked dataset, repeated trials, pinned model/tool configurations or independent harness comparisons appear. CAND-2026-08-31-C43E30F0 — China's Intelligent Chemical Model 3.0 Pro moves a vertical model toward tool-executing chemical-engineering workflows — revisit if: Technical report, benchmark protocol, model/data card, reproducible agent tasks, pilot-plant closed-loop results, safety/audit details or independent industrial evaluation appears. CAND-2026-08-31-CHINA-NATIONAL-AI-COMPUTE-SCALE — China reports 2.45 million PFLOPS FP16 of national intelligent-compute capacity and expanding centralized scheduling — revisit if: National Data Administration publishes methodology, accelerator inventory/utilization, energy data, task-level scheduling statistics, or independent capacity estimates suitable for cross-country comparison. CAND-2026-08-31-CN-AI-APPLICATION-SERVICE-PROVIDERS — China MIIT launches national AI application-service-provider program with explicit demand-side procurement support — revisit if: new evidence CAND-2026-08-31-CONFIDENCE-CHANNEL-DIVERGENCE — Linguistic confidence is a lossy and poorly calibrated channel for internal model confidence — revisit if: Independent reproduction, stronger black-box calibration methods, or adaptive-compute/agent-routing studies compare verbal confidence against internal or ensemble uncertainty at matched cost. CAND-2026-08-31-CXMT-HBM4-SIGNAL — Signal: CXMT reportedly begins small-scale HBM4 production — revisit if: CXMT or a named customer confirms HBM4 shipments/specifications, teardown/benchmark evidence appears, packaging partners disclose volume, or multiple independent sources corroborate yield and scale. CAND-2026-08-31-EU-CHATGPT-VLOSE — European Commission designates ChatGPT a Very Large Online Search Engine under the DSA — revisit if: Commission publishes the designation decision, compliance deadlines, systemic-risk assessment, audit requirements, data-access measures, enforcement action or OpenAI implementation details.
